phase3_findings.description: The trusted-source ladder for materialize-trusted-prompt-extensions.sh omits the vendor_source==fetch rank every sibling closure carries. On the DEFAULT THIN INSTALL both existing ranks fail (the vendored copy is gitignored so it is not on the base ref; a consumer base ref is not the devflow plugin repo), so the closure is never populated and the no-trusted-source ::warning:: fires on every review run while the workspace copies are already truncated.

The unconditional truncation writes through a PR-author-controlled symlink: `: > path` follows symlinks, so a PR committing .devflow/prompt-extensions/review.md as a symlink makes the review job truncate the target instead — silently, exit 0. Reachable before ci_summary and harden_hooks.
The three never-established arms emit ::warning:: while AC 18, the adjacent comment, and the helper's own arm all say NOTICE. The helper's ::notice:: arm is unreachable from the workflow.

Sourcing vendor's ref solely from the base ref turns two previously-degraded paths into a hard review-job failure on the fetch branch: a transient base-ref fetch failure, and a repo enabling DevFlow via the PR itself (base ref has no config at all).
Two diff-added comments assert 'install.sh creates no .devflow/prompt-extensions/' while the same diff added exactly that mkdir.
`|| true` at the materialization call site swallows the helper's exit-2 usage error and its empty-trusted-copy no-op arm — two unannotated non-population arms beyond the documented four.
baseversion: a base ref carrying no .devflow/config.json is a fully silent arm (the `if RAW=$(git show ...)` has no else), converging with the legitimately-silent absent-key shape.

The stdout-only classification rule has no mechanism the agent can execute: the Bash tool merges stdout and stderr into one blob with no stream labels, so on the common empty-extension shape the breadcrumb is the only text and the agent reports loaded-with-content.
resolved-root is emitted but nothing consumes it, so the 'observable rather than silent' claim is undischarged; resolved-root=unset also collapses four distinct states.
git show FETCH_HEAD:<path> exits 0 on a TREE, so a directory at a protected extension path writes a tree listing into the closure, which the loader would cat into the reviewer's prompt.
matcher-probe comment and docs claim the implementing run does not run the probe, but the job auto-fires on a same-repo pull_request touching matcher-probe.yml — which this PR does.
env-propagation-probe-verdict.py docstring enumerates a four-way verdict; compute_verdict selects among five (DISPATCHED_TASK_ONLY missing).
A self-referential count ('the fifteen other skills/*/SKILL.md load sites') is wrong and is the documented rot class.
'no runtime arm writes to STDERR' is falsifiable: `git show ... > "$dest" 2>/dev/null` reports a redirect failure on the real stderr before the redirection applies.
The helper header claims lib/test/run.sh compares BOTH shapes with cmp; no test constructs the command-substitution shape. The protective consequence is real but the stated mechanism does not exist.

baseversion is branch-selecting inline workflow shell with a config-JSON parse, covered only by grep counts; the adversarial matrix rows (non-scalar devflow_version corrupting GITHUB_OUTPUT, valid-falsy, absent-config vs malformed) are untested.

env-propagation-probe-verdict.py: the partial-corruption arm and the nested-document walk are both unexercised; every fixture is flat single-level while real execution files nest tool_use inside message.content[].
The executed promptext tests hardcode the protected set instead of reading its single declaration site, so a third protected name would pass the drift guard while its truncation is never exercised.
The closure path is a two-site coupled literal in the workflow with no assertion tying the sites together.
phase-3-agents.md states the stderr breadcrumb unconditionally, but the same prose runs on tiers where the variable is unset and no breadcrumb appears; the sibling edits are correctly hedged.

extension_load_state: loaded-empty resolved-root=unset (local tier; notice-suppression flag SET — vendored helper absent and GITHUB_ACTIONS unset)
